name: restart-loop
summary: Starting the service with an invalid config value makes startup validation throw before listen(); the container restart policy then crash-loops with a byte-identical stack trace.
expected_log_signature: Error: Invalid VICTIM_API_KEY: expected 32-char lowercase hex
ground_truth: The service validates VICTIM_API_KEY while loading configuration at startup and throws because the value is not a 32-character lowercase hex string. The process exits before binding its port, and Docker's restart policy starts it again endlessly, repeating the identical startup stack trace on every cycle.
